text:
maria: Quick sync — final dress rehearsal tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to lock run-of-show and confirm speaker transitions + dry-run checklist.

devon: 10 is good. can we add 5 minutes after the demo for live Qs and buffer?

aj: yes, demo is set for slot 4. will have a 30s fallback video just in case model latency spikes. :movie_camera:

sophie: I can shift my examples earlier by 2 mins to give Aj more time to set up. also we should test cold-start and 200 concurrent small requests during the dry-run.

maria: agenda: 1) intro (2m) 2) benchmarks highlight (4m) 3) panel + product updates (10m) 4) live demo (8m) 5) audience Q&A (10m). Aj demo will include 3 input prompts + 1 adversarial stress case.

devon: for benchmark highlights, let's avoid exact microsecond claims. use phrasing: "tail latencies remain low at scale" and cite our Dedicated config numbers in the notes.

aj: draft copy for slide: "99th percentile tail latency under load stays below ~350ms in our Dedicated test harness." open to edits.

sophie: good. also call out the reliability/fallback line: "automatic region fallback and model-variant degrade path reduce visible errors." marketing should include a small diagram.

maria: Aj, paste the exact prompts you'll run so we can put them verbatim on slides (3 normal + 1 adversarial).

aj: posting prompt snippet: ```
# Demo prompt set
1) "Summarize incident runbook: sudden traffic spike with 20% errors"
2) "Rewrite this feature blurb for developer audiences: <short blurb>"
3) "Compose safe-by-default chat response that asks clarifying questions for ambiguous legal queries"
# Adversarial
4) Long-streaming input: 8K tokens lorem + burst of short queries at 100rps
```

maria: perfect. marketing will put these verbatim into the demo slide so we can replay the same inputs.

deploy-bot: rehearsal event scheduled for 5278965000 with reminders at 30m and 5m.

devon: ops dry-run checklist: - confirm model pinned version - enable KV cache warmup - set autoscale capped burst - routing policy: Dedicated preferred, Hosted fallback

aj: I will send a mini-runbook with warmup command. example: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/demo/requests \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"warmup token stream", "count":20}'
```

sophie: marketing can make a 1-liner slide explaining fallback in plain english; I'll provide the diagram notes.

maria: thanks — final ask: react with :thumbsup: once confirmed availability and that prompt list is good.

aj: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

sophie: :thumbsup:

maria: great, see you tomorrow.
